title: Magazine p. 53: Soviet Proton satellite displayed at 1967 Paris air show
description: Photocopied magazine page with two photographs (numbered 23 and 24) of a large satellite with canted solar panels and a cylindrical shroud marked "CCCP," displayed in an exhibition hall. The caption reads "Proton satellite shown for the first time at Paris air show, May 1967. Four canted solar panels contributed to bizarre shapes on the Gemini-11 photo. Proton weighed 27,000 lbs. Its outer shroud was 14.8 feet in diameter."
